text: Darjeeling is a Himalayan hill town in West Bengal known for tea gardens, colonial-era architecture, Tibetan monasteries and the heritage Toy Train.
The Darjeeling guide lists the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, Happy Valley Tea Estate, Tiger Hill, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Observatory Hill and Singalila National Park.
The Incredible India travel listing names Bagdogra International Airport (IXB) and New Jalpaiguri Junction Railway Station (NJP) for access to Darjeeling.
Darjeeling's guide highlights local tea and describes estate tours and tea tastings as visitor experiences.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
Kolkata, the City of Joy, is a cultural and historic city on the Hooghly, known for colonial landmarks, markets, museums and street food.
The Kolkata guide highlights Howrah Bridge, Victoria Memorial, the Maidan, Indian Museum, New Market and Kumartuli.
Kolkata is served by Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Airport (CCU), Howrah Railway Station (HWH) and Sealdah Railway Station (SDAH), per Incredible India.
The Kolkata guide mentions biryani, sweets and roadside tea stalls, and describes Park Street as a dining and street-food area.
